items.title: Thailand to Ban Export of Chemicals to Myanmar Rare-Earth Mines
items.author: Patpicha Tanakasempipat
items.content: <article>Thailand is set to issue a ban on Monday on exports of chemicals used in rare-earth mining in Myanmar, after elevated arsenic levels in rivers in the north raised a public health alarm.</article>

items.title: United Fidelity Shut in Biggest US Bank Failure in Two Years
items.author: Olivia Poh
items.content: <article>US federal regulators closed down Indiana-based United Fidelity Bank on Friday after finding the lender was likely unable to pay its obligations, the country’s largest bank failure in two years.</article>

items.title: Bots de compras con IA amenazan el dominio de Amazon y Google
items.author: Spencer Soper
items.content: Google, Amazon, Meta y OpenAI compiten por ayudarte a elegir los regalos de Navidad. ¿A quién escucharán los compradores?

items.title: OpenAI Says Apple Pressured Suppliers to Shun Its Devices
items.author: Erik Larson
items.content: <article>The trade-secrets fight between OpenAI and Apple Inc. is widening, with the artificial intelligence company accusing the iPhone maker of undermining its supplier relationships and using unfair employment agreements to prevent talent from jumping ship.</article>

items.title: Verizon in Talks to Buy Fidium in $6 Billion Deal, FT Says
items.author: Lynn Doan and Kelcee Griffis
items.content: <article>Verizon Communications Inc. is in talks to buy the broadband operator Fidium in a $6 billion deal, the Financial Times reported, a move that would expand its network and allow the mobile giant to target more internet service subscribers across the US.</article>

items.title: GTA VI’s Success Makes the Case for Human-Made Games
items.content: <article>Grand Theft Auto VI arrived after 13 years in development and it was made without using any generative AI according to Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick. It smashed all kinds of records. Gordon Bellamy, Director of Ethics at the USC School of Cinematic Arts, discusses what Rockstar’s blockbuster says about the value of human-made content in the AI era, why its extraordinary launch could reshape holiday spending across the gaming industry, and what smaller studios can learn from GTA VI’s success. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: How AI Is Changing Black Friday
items.content: <article>Matt Shay, president and CEO of the National Retail Federation, says this may mark a step change in how consumers interact with retailers, as AI begins changing how shoppers shop on Black Friday. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: UK Pension Agency Takes Systems Offline After Cyber Incident
items.author: Ryan Gallagher and Lucy White
items.content: <article>The UK government’s Department for Work and Pensions took systems offline on Friday as a precautionary measure after officials detected a cyber incident.</article>

items.title: Nvidia Blackwell Chips Turn Up at China Site Tied to Alice Huang
items.content:
<article>A pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp.’s powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of a controversy surrounding the US chipmaker. 
The gear installed at the Yangtze River Delta Project included a GB300 NVL72 rack, among Nvidia’s most powerful products, according to a serial number specified in documents submitted to Chinese regulators in November. Shanghai Shuoyao offered the hardware as collateral to obtain a 96 million yuan ($14 million) loan from Shanghai Innovation Bank, according to filings from the lender that were reviewed by Bloomberg News.
Bloomberg's Tom Keene and Paul Sweeney get details from Olivia Levieux, Markets Strategist with Bloomberg News (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Poland Signs $300 Million Palantir Deal to Use AI in Defense
items.author: Zosia Wanat
items.content: <article>Poland will use artificial intelligence-based software from Palantir Technologies Inc. to analyze battlefield data, bucking a push by some European allies to reduce their reliance on US technology for critical defense capabilities.</article>
